# PI Web API fixtures (spec 022)

The answers of a small PI System, served by `tests/pi_fake.py` to the `pi_web_api` connector
tests. The project has no PI test server (S9 owner input in `docs/roadmap/sprints.md`), so they
are **built from the response shapes in AVEVA's PI Web API reference**
(<https://docs.aveva.com/bundle/pi-web-api-reference/page/help.html>), not recorded:

| File | Reference action |
|---|---|
| `dataserver.json` | `GET dataservers?path=` (DataServer GetByPath) |
| `assetdatabase.json` | `GET assetdatabases?path=` (AssetDatabase GetByPath) |
| `points.json` | `GET points?path=`, one object per PI point; also `dataservers/{webId}/points` items |
| `point_attributes.json` | `GET points/{webId}/attributes` |
| `attributes.json` | `GET attributes?path=`; also `assetdatabases/{webId}/elementattributes` items |
| `traits.json` | `GET attributes/{webId}/attributes?traitCategory=Limit`, and the trait values |
| `recorded_items.json` | value items of `GET streams/{webId}/recorded` that are not plain numbers |

Recorded values of the analog points are generated by `pi_fake.py` (a minute grid with the
special items of `recorded_items.json` mixed in), so a day's worth need not be checked in.

**Replacing them with real recordings:** run the same requests against a PI Web API with
`selectedFields` as in `tabayyun/connectors/pi_web_api/connector.py`, keep the field names,
replace host names with `pi.example.com`, server names with `PISRV01`/`AFSRV01`, and WebIds
with the ones these files use (or update `pi_fake.py`'s table). The tests assert on behaviour
(paging, quality, errors), not on the generated numbers.
